events.hook: Hunt, sniff and shave the world's most expensive truffle across Piedmont's vineyards.
events.overview: Alba's autumn fair has a truffle market, tastings, cooking demos and truffle hunts with dogs. Late fall is also Barolo and Barbaresco season, with foggy hills and cozy trattorie. It is a food trip with a distinct sense of place.
events.costNotes: White truffle meals are expensive, so food costs trend high.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miniato, Italy","event":"White truffle festival (mid-to-late Nov)","note":"A Tuscan hill-town truffle fair, less crowded than Alba."},{"destination":"Istria, Croatia","event":"Truffle season in Motovun","note":"Truffle hunts and cheaper dining than Piedmont."}]

events.hook: Marigold-strewn cemeteries, sand-tapestry altars and candlelit all-night vigils make this the world's most moving party for the dead.
events.overview: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead blends Zapotec tradition and Catholic ritual, with comparsas (costumed processions), altars in every home and plaza, and overnight graveside gatherings in villages like Xoxocotlán. Nov 1-2 are the heart of it. Mezcal, mole and pan de muerto make it a food trip as well.
events.costNotes: Peak-week lodging is pricey and sells out months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pátzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Janitzio island night vigil","note":"Candlelit lake vigil with a more rural, traditional feel."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Day of the Dead parade and ofrendas","note":"Big-city altar displays and a huge parade, with easy flights from LAX."}]

events.hook: Two million spectators line five boroughs of pure noise and energy.
events.overview: The world's largest marathon winds from Staten Island through Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Manhattan to finish in Central Park. Spectating is a spectacle in itself, and you can make a trip of it with fall color, Broadway and the city's food scene.
events.costNotes: Race day is Sunday, so book flights and lodging immediately.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Boston, USA","event":"Late-fall foliage and harbor culture","note":"A quieter East Coast alternative with a walkable historic core."},{"destination":"Philadelphia, USA","event":"Autumn city break","note":"Cheaper lodging and strong food and history."}]

events.hook: The race that stops a nation, with fascinators, champagne and a public holiday in Victoria.
events.overview: Run at Flemington Racecourse on the first Tuesday of November, the Melbourne Cup is a 3,200 m race and a fashion parade. The surrounding Cup Carnival and the city's laneway culture, coffee and spring weather make it an easy trip to build.
events.costNotes: Cup-week lodging spikes, and Flemington tickets sell out.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Barossa Valley spring wine season","note":"Wine country within easy reach of the city."},{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Harbour spring season and Cup Day parties","note":"The same Cup excitement with beach and harbor options."}]

events.hook: Torch-bearing processions, burning tar barrels and giant effigies in Britain's wildest bonfire celebration.
events.overview: Lewes' Bonfire Societies march in historic and smuggler costumes, carry flaming crosses and stage fireworks in a tradition that goes back centuries. It is dramatic, loud and crowded, with several bonfire sites and a strong sense of local identity. Stay in nearby Brighton, because Lewes is largely closed to visitors by evening.
events.costNotes: Stay in Brighton or London; late trains are the main challenge.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ottery St Mary, England","event":"Tar Barrels","note":"Another old English fire festival, usually held on the Saturday closest to Nov 5."},{"destination":"Edinburgh, Scotland","event":"Bonfire Night fireworks and the Old Town in autumn","note":"A moodier and more atmospheric option."}]

events.hook: The Pink City lights up with millions of lamps, fireworks and glowing bazaars.
events.overview: Diwali is India's biggest festival, and Jaipur's markets such as Johari and Bapu Bazaar are strung with lights for the occasion. Expect sweets, rangoli, Lakshmi puja at palaces and homes, and fireworks on the main night of Nov 8. It is energetic and sensory, and it is easy to combine with Rajasthan's forts.
events.costNotes: Flights via the Gulf or Europe cost more near Diwali, but India itself is cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Diwali and Dev Deepawali (Nov 24)","note":"Ghats lined with a million lamps on the Ganges."},{"destination":"Singapore","event":"Deepavali in Little India","note":"A tidy, easy version of Diwali with a light-up and a street bazaar."}]

events.hook: Tens of thousands of camels, desert musicians and a holy lake bath on the full moon.
events.overview: This Rajasthani livestock fair in the dunes has camel trading, races, turban-tying contests and folk performances. It builds toward Kartik Purnima (Nov 24), when pilgrims bathe in Pushkar Lake. It is lesser-known, rural and photogenic.
events.costNotes: Tent camps and guesthouses are cheap but fill up quickly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sonepur, India","event":"Sonepur Mela","note":"Asia's largest cattle fair, held in Bihar around the same full moon."},{"destination":"Jaisalmer, India","event":"Thar desert camps","note":"Dunes, forts and folk music with fewer crowds."}]

events.hook: Swahili dhow races, donkey races and henna contests on a car-free UNESCO island.
events.overview: Lamu Old Town is a centuries-old Swahili settlement with no cars and narrow lanes. The festival showcases its heritage through dhow sailing races, traditional dance, poetry and crafts. It is little known outside East Africa and combines well with the island's beaches and nearby Manda.
events.costNotes: Flights go via Nairobi, plus a short hop to Lamu; check dates before booking.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Stone Town and spice culture","note":"A similar Swahili heritage with more tourist infrastructure."},{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Marrakech International Film Festival (late Nov/early Dec, dates unconfirmed)","note":"A different vibe, but strong on culture."}]

events.hook: Thousands of glowing lanterns drift into the night sky above the old city.
events.overview: At the full moon of the 12th lunar month, Chiang Mai releases sky lanterns for Yi Peng and floats krathong baskets on the Ping River for Loy Krathong. Parades, temple ceremonies and night markets fill the old city. It is among the most photographed festivals in Asia.
events.costNotes: Lodging peaks around the full moon, so book months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sukhothai, Thailand","event":"Loy Krathong at the historical park","note":"The festival's traditional birthplace, with a light show among ruins."},{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Boun Lai Heua Fai","note":"A quieter river festival with boat lanterns."}]

events.hook: France's oldest Christmas market glows beneath a giant tree in the 'Capital of Christmas'.
events.overview: Strasbourg's market dates to 1570, with chalets across the medieval center, mulled wine (vin chaud), bredele cookies and tarte flambée. Opening weekend is less crowded than December, and Alsace's villages are within easy reach.
events.costNotes: Prices jump in December, so late November is the better value.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Colmar, France","event":"Colmar Christmas Markets","note":"A small, picturesque market town in the same region."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Christkindlmarkt at the Rathaus (opens mid-Nov)","note":"Grander and more imperial in feel."}]

events.hook: Nagaland's 17 Naga tribes gather in one village for ten days of war dances, rice beer and hornbill-feathered pageantry.
events.overview: Held at Kisama Heritage Village near Kohima, the Hornbill Festival is a showcase of Naga music, ritual, crafts and food, with traditional morungs, folk songs, wrestling and a rock contest. It is little known in the West and one of the most culturally rich gatherings in India's northeast.
events.costNotes: Includes a domestic hop to Dimapur and permit and transfer costs; homestays near Kohima fill up fast.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Fort Kochi, India","event":"Cochin Carnival (Dec 18 - Jan 1)","note":"Fort Kochi's colonial streets host a New Year carnival with parades and a huge Pappanji effigy burning."},{"destination":"Kutch, India","event":"Rann Utsav white desert festival","note":"A tent-city folk-music festival on the salt flats, running through winter."}]

events.hook: Giant lantern-lit floats are hauled up a winter hill, with fireworks bursting overhead.
events.overview: One of Japan's three great float festivals, with a 300-year history. Huge carved floats are pulled through Chichibu's streets, and on the night of Dec 3 they climb the steep slope to the town's main square under fireworks. It is a spectacular, local-feeling alternative to Kyoto or Tokyo, only 80 minutes from Tokyo.
events.costNotes: Based in Tokyo with a day trip or one night in Chichibu; the festival is free, with some paid viewing seats.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kobe, Japan","event":"Kobe Luminarie (early-mid Dec)","note":"Millions of lights form glowing arcades in memory of the 1995 earthquake."},{"destination":"Sapporo, Japan","event":"White Illumination and Munich Christmas Market","note":"Snowy Hokkaido lights, markets and winter food through Dec 25."}]

events.hook: Four nights when an entire city becomes a canvas of light installations and projections.
events.overview: Born from a 1852 vow to the Virgin Mary, Lyon's Festival of Lights now draws millions to see projections on landmarks such as Place des Terreaux and Fourvière. Lyon's bouchons and chocolate pralines make it a first-rate food trip too.
events.costNotes: Hotels and rentals spike during the festival, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmarik Christmas Market","note":"One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets, open until Dec 24."},{"destination":"Geneva, Switzerland","event":"L'Escalade (about Dec 11-13)","note":"A historic costumed parade and chocolate-cauldron smashing in the old town."}]

events.hook: The Nobel ceremony and the candlelit Lucia processions fall in the same dark-December week.
events.overview: Dec 10 is Nobel Prize Day, with the ceremony and banquet in Stockholm, while Dec 13 brings Sweden's Lucia celebrations, with white-robed choirs and saffron buns in churches across the city. Add Gamla Stan Christmas markets and glögg for a very Nordic week.
events.costNotes: Nordic prices; the Nobel banquet is invitation-only, but public lectures and the city atmosphere are free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Copenhagen, Denmark","event":"Tivoli Gardens Christmas season","note":"Lights, markets and rides in the historic amusement park."},{"destination":"Tromso, Norway","event":"Polar night and aurora season","note":"Northern lights and whale watching in the dark of December."}]

events.hook: The African diaspora returns to Accra for beach parties, Afrobeats concerts and nonstop nightlife.
events.overview: Detty December is Accra's season of concerts, beach days, art events, food and fashion, drawing visitors from across the diaspora. Expect big Afrobeats lineups, rooftop parties and a packed calendar into the New Year. Specific event dates are announced late, so book the flexible parts.
events.costNotes: Prices for housing and flights surge in the final two weeks of December.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lagos, Nigeria","event":"December concerts and Afrobeats season","note":"A bigger, louder alternative with a huge music scene."},{"destination":"Cape Town, South Africa","event":"Summer festival season","note":"Beach days, open-air concerts and the run-up to Kaapse Klopse in early January."}]

events.event: Night of the Radishes (Noche de Rábanos)
events.hook: Artists carve giant radishes into nativity scenes and folk legends in Oaxaca's main square.
events.overview: A one-night Oaxacan tradition dating to 1897, when growers carved oversized radishes to attract buyers. Today competitors build intricate dioramas in the zócalo, and queues wind around the square. Oaxaca's mezcal bars and mole kitchens make the trip.
events.costNotes: Holiday-season flights and rentals are priced at a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Las Posadas (Dec 16-24)","note":"Candlelit neighborhood processions and piñatas lead up to Christmas."},{"destination":"Patzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Christmas in Michoacan","note":"Lake-town holiday traditions and artisan markets with few tourists."}]

events.event: Junkanoo Boxing Day and New Year's Day Parades
events.hook: Dawn-to-dusk street parades of cowbells, goatskin drums and enormous handmade costumes.
events.overview: Junkanoo is the Bahamas' signature cultural festival, with rival groups competing on Bay Street from the early hours of Boxing Day and New Year's Day. The costumes are paper-and-cardboard masterpieces, and the energy is infectious. It pairs easily with beach time and conch fritters.
events.costNotes: Holiday week hotel and rental prices are high; flights from LAX usually connect via Miami or Atlanta.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Freeport, Bahamas","event":"Grand Bahama Junkanoo","note":"A smaller-scale parade with an easier-going crowd."},{"destination":"San Juan, Puerto Rico","event":"Navidad parrandas and Christmas season","note":"Puerto Rico's long holiday season of music, food and gatherings."}]

events.hook: Over a hundred yachts race out of Sydney Harbour on Boxing Day in one of the world's toughest ocean races.
events.overview: The 628-nautical-mile race leaves Sydney Harbour at 1 pm on Boxing Day, with spectators crowding the foreshore and boats. You can watch the start from Sydney's headlands, then fly to Hobart to see the finishers arrive and join the Tasmanian summer festivities.
events.costNotes: Peak summer holiday pricing for flights and rentals.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Boxing Day Test at the MCG","note":"Test cricket in front of 80,000+ fans starting Dec 26."},{"destination":"Hobart, Australia","event":"Taste of Tasmania (about Dec 28 - Jan 3)","note":"Seafood and local produce at the waterfront finish of the yacht race."}]

events.hook: Torchlight procession, street party and fireworks beneath the castle for Scotland's New Year.
events.overview: Hogmanay is one of the world's biggest New Year celebrations, with a torchlight procession, concerts, ceilidhs and fireworks over Edinburgh Castle. The city's old town is atmospheric in winter, and a pub whisky is always close by.
events.costNotes: Ticketed street-party entry and peak New Year accommodation drive up costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"New Year's Eve bonfires and fireworks","note":"The whole city lights fireworks and communal bonfires."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Silvesterpfad New Year's street party","note":"Waltz, classical concerts and an old-town party route."}]

events.hook: Two million people in white on Copacabana Beach for fireworks and a summer-night concert.
events.overview: Cariocas dress in white, throw flowers to Iemanja and watch a big fireworks show over the Atlantic, with free stage concerts along the beach. It is a lively, summery, very Brazilian way to start the year.
events.costNotes: New Year's rentals often have minimum stays and premium prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Medellin, Colombia","event":"Alumbrados Christmas lights","note":"The city's rivers and parks glow with massive holiday lighting displays."},{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"New Year's Eve Harbour fireworks","note":"A warm-weather New Year with the Harbour Bridge as backdrop."}]

events.event: Harbin International Ice and Snow Festival
events.hook: Walk through a glowing city of building-sized ice castles at -20°C.
events.overview: The world's largest ice and snow festival opens officially in early January. Giant illuminated ice sculptures fill Ice and Snow World and the Sun Island snow expo, with ice lanterns and winter swimming along the Songhua River. Visit in January for the thickest, cleanest ice.
events.costNotes: Includes a China visa or transit-exemption allowance and heavy cold-weather gear rental.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sapporo, Japan","event":"Preparations for Sapporo Snow Festival (early Feb) plus Otaru winter lights","note":"Same snow-sculpture vibe with easier logistics, though the main festival starts after January."},{"destination":"Jilin City, China","event":"Rime ice (wusong) season and winter fishing","note":"Lesser-visited frozen landscapes with the same deep-freeze atmosphere."}]

events.hook: Thousands of white-clad Bahians wash church steps in a sea of song and flowers.
events.overview: Each January, a long procession winds roughly 8 km from Conceição da Praia to the Bonfim church. Baianas in white wash the steps with scented water in a Catholic and Candomblé blend. Street parties and live music run through the week, a warm-up to Salvador's summer season.
events.costNotes: Southern summer fares; the washing day falls on a Thursday.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Olinda, Brazil","event":"Pre-Carnival street blocos","note":"Early Carnival rehearsals with a smaller, more local feel."},{"destination":"Havana, Cuba","event":"Havana International Book Fair lead-up and Afro-Cuban rumba","note":"Similar Afro-Caribbean music and spiritual culture, with extra travel rules for US travelers."}]

events.hook: Three weeks of free concerts, theatre and big-top spectacle in peak Australian summer.
events.overview: Sydney's major summer arts festival fills the city with music, dance, circus and outdoor performances. Many events are free, and venues run from the Domain to Parramatta. Pair it with harbour swims and beach days.
events.costNotes: Peak summer pricing for flights and housing.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Adelaide Fringe lead-up and summer music events","note":"Smaller crowds and lower prices with a similar arts-and-outdoors vibe, though Fringe itself starts in February."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Auckland Anniversary Weekend and summer regatta","note":"Harbour-city summer festivities with a more relaxed pace."}]

events.hook: Masked Egungun dancers, drumming and ancestral rituals in the birthplace of Vodun.
events.overview: Benin's national Vodun Day draws practitioners, drummers and masked spirit dancers to the coastal town of Ouidah. Ceremonies and processions happen on the beach by the Door of No Return and throughout town. It is an unusually direct window into a living West African religion.
events.costNotes: Includes e-visa, Cotonou transfers and local guides; flights usually connect through Europe.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lomé, Togo","event":"Festivals and Vodun markets around Akodessewa","note":"Nearby alternative for Vodun culture and a quick combined trip."},{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Lavagem do Bonfim","note":"Afro-Brazilian spiritual traditions with the same Yoruba roots."}]

events.hook: Priests carry the sacred Tabot to a royal bath for Ethiopia's most colorful ceremony.
events.overview: Timkat commemorates the baptism of Jesus with processions of priests in embroidered robes, umbrellas, drums and sistrums. In Gondar, Fasilides' Bath is filled for a mass blessing and joyful water-splashing on the final day. It is also a gateway to Lalibela and the Simien Mountains.
events.costNotes: Domestic flights to Gondar or Lalibela included in experiential costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Timkat at the rock-hewn churches","note":"Smaller and more atmospheric, with pilgrims filling the churches."},{"destination":"Addis Ababa, Ethiopia","event":"Timkat at Jan Meda","note":"Easiest logistics with the largest procession in the capital."}]

events.hook: The first Grand Slam of the year, played under the Melbourne summer sun.
events.overview: Melbourne Park hosts two weeks of top tennis, with ground passes offering access to outer courts. The atmosphere spills into Federation Square and the city's bars and laneways. Finals weekend brings the biggest crowds.
events.costNotes: Includes session tickets; housing is at peak summer rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"ASB Classic tennis (early Jan) and summer festivals","note":"A cheaper tennis warm-up before Melbourne."},{"destination":"Perth, Australia","event":"Perth Festival and summer cricket","note":"Western Australia's sunny sports-and-arts alternative."}]

events.hook: A 24-hour drum parade in which the whole Basque city turns cook and soldier.
events.overview: At midnight on Jan 19 the flag is raised at Plaza de la Constitución and thousands of costumed drummers march until midnight on Jan 20. Companies dressed as Napoleonic soldiers and chefs bang on barrels and drums. Time it with pintxos crawls in the Old Town.
events.costNotes: Off-season Europe fares; food spend is high due to the pintxos scene.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bilbao, Spain","event":"Winter pintxo season and Basque culture events","note":"Lower costs and a vibrant food scene nearby."},{"destination":"Pamplona, Spain","event":"San Sebastián-area winter folklore and carnivals","note":"Another Basque-country city with a strong traditional-festival vibe."}]

events.hook: The biggest free literary gathering on Earth, held in a Pink City palace.
events.overview: Authors, poets and thinkers from around the world gather at Diggi Palace for talks, music and evening programs. Jaipur's forts, bazaars and palace hotels make it easy to extend into Rajasthan. Winter weather is at its best.
events.costNotes: Accommodation near the festival sells out early; prices spike that week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ahmedabad, India","event":"International Kite Festival (around Jan 14) and Uttarayan","note":"Earlier in the month and a spectacular sky-filled celebration."},{"destination":"Udaipur, India","event":"Winter palace weddings and heritage events","note":"Lake-palace romance with a more relaxed pace."}]

events.hook: Nearly a thousand torch-bearing 'Vikings' burn a longship in Shetland's fire festival.
events.overview: On the last Tuesday of January, the Guizer Jarl and his squad lead a torchlit procession through Lerwick and set fire to a replica Viking galley. The night continues with hall parties across town. Tickets to the halls are limited and local, so plan well ahead.
events.costNotes: Includes flights to Edinburgh/Glasgow and onward to Shetland; accommodation is scarce.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kirkwall, United Kingdom","event":"Orkney Ba' Game and winter folklore","note":"Another northern-island tradition, with Christmas/New Year events earlier."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Northern Lights season and Sami culture events","note":"Arctic-winter drama, with the Sami Week events in early February."}]

events.hook: Bonhomme's snowy party takes over a walled French-Canadian city.
events.overview: One of the world's biggest winter carnivals fills the Plains of Abraham with ice palaces, snow sculptures, night parades and canoe races on the St. Lawrence. Warm up with Caribou and poutine. Quebec City's old town is at its most charming under snow.
events.costNotes: Dates are estimates; the festival starts on the last Friday of January.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Montréal, Canada","event":"Igloofest electronic music series","note":"Outdoor winter dance parties by the Old Port."},{"destination":"Saint Paul, USA","event":"Saint Paul Winter Carnival","note":"A US-based winter festival with ice sculpture and parades, usually late Jan to early Feb."}]

events.event: Festividad de la Virgen de la Candelaria
events.hook: Thousands of dancers in sequined costumes fill the streets above Lake Titicaca.
events.overview: Peru's folkloric capital celebrates its patron saint for about two weeks, with devil masks, Andean brass bands and competing dance troupes. The big parades and the dance competition fall in the first weeks of February, and Aymara and Quechua traditions are on full display. Combine it with a Titicaca island homestay for an unusual trip.
events.costNotes: Flights connect via Lima, and lodging in Puno is cheap but fills up for the parade days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Oruro, Bolivia","event":"Carnaval de Oruro (Entrada about Feb 6)","note":"UNESCO-listed Diablada parade in the high Andes."},{"destination":"Cajamarca, Peru","event":"Cajamarca Carnival (February)","note":"Water-fight street party with a traditional northern Andean flavor."}]

events.hook: Building-sized snow sculptures glow in Odori Park while ramen steams on every corner.
events.overview: Hokkaido's famous winter festival fills Odori Park, Susukino and Tsudome with huge snow and ice sculptures that are lit up at night. Come early for the best powder at nearby ski resorts, and eat miso ramen, crab and soup curry between sights. Hotels in Sapporo sell out months ahead.
events.costNotes: Festival-week lodging carries a premium, and winter gear and a day trip to Otaru are in the activity cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Otaru, Japan","event":"Otaru Snow Light Path Festival (mid-Feb)","note":"A candlelit canal town 40 minutes from Sapporo, quieter and more romantic."},{"destination":"Harbin, China","event":"Harbin Ice and Snow Festival (runs into Feb)","note":"Larger ice-castle spectacle in deep cold."}]

events.hook: Peach blossoms, flower markets and fireworks over Hoan Kiem Lake for Vietnam's biggest holiday.
events.overview: Lunar New Year falls on Feb 6, 2027, and Hanoi turns into a sea of kumquat trees and peach blossoms, with midnight fireworks and family temple visits. Many shops close for several days, but the city feels most alive and photogenic at this time. Go in the week before Tết for the markets and stay through the first days for the temples.
events.costNotes: Flights are at holiday-season highs, while lodging and food stay inexpensive.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hong Kong","event":"Lunar New Year Parade and fireworks (Feb 6-8)","note":"Night parade, harbor fireworks and flower markets in a compact city."},{"destination":"Penang, Malaysia","event":"Chinese New Year and Chap Goh Meh (Feb 20)","note":"Clan-house celebrations and street food on a heritage island."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest party, with samba schools parading under floodlights until sunrise.
events.overview: Carnival runs from the Friday before Ash Wednesday (Feb 10, 2027), and the Sambadrome parades fall on the Sunday and Monday nights. Alongside them, hundreds of street blocos fill every neighborhood from morning to night. Book far ahead, since Carnival week is the most expensive and sold-out week of the year.
events.costNotes: Carnival-week Airbnb prices run 2-3x normal and Sambadrome tickets are included in the activity budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"Mardi Gras parades (Fat Tuesday Feb 9)","note":"Krewe parades peak in the final weekend, and it is a cheap, short flight from LAX."},{"destination":"Barranquilla, Colombia","event":"Carnaval de Barranquilla (Battle of Flowers about Feb 6)","note":"UNESCO-recognized carnival with cumbia and costume parades, at a lower price than Rio."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of ostrich-plumed Gilles march to drums and throw oranges at the crowd.
events.overview: This UNESCO-listed carnival peaks on Shrove Tuesday (Feb 9), when costumed Gilles in huge feather hats dance through the town from dawn into the evening. It is a centuries-old ritual that is less touristed than Venice or Cologne. Binche is an easy day or overnight trip from Brussels, and the Sunday and Monday build-up is worth seeing too.
events.costNotes: Base yourself in Brussels or Mons, where lodging is more plentiful than in Binche.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cologne, Germany","event":"Rosenmontag parade (Feb 8)","note":"A huge street carnival with a million costumed revelers."},{"destination":"Venice, Italy","event":"Carnevale di Venezia (late Jan - Feb 9)","note":"Masked balls and costume parades through the canals."}]

events.hook: Lanterns, communal iftar tables and all-night cafes make Cairo's Ramadan one of the most atmospheric in the world.
events.overview: Ramadan is expected to start around Feb 8, 2027, depending on the moon sighting. Fanous lanterns light up Al-Muizz Street and Khan el-Khalili, and charity iftar tables line the streets at sunset. Daytime is quiet and nights are lively, so plan your sightseeing around it.
events.costNotes: Moderate winter fares, with a guide and pyramid or museum entries in the activity cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Istanbul, Türkiye","event":"Ramadan evenings in Sultanahmet and Eyüp","note":"Mosque lights, drummers and iftar feasts along the Bosphorus."},{"destination":"Amman, Jordan","event":"Ramadan in downtown Amman","note":"Lively food stalls at night, with Petra a short trip away."}]

events.hook: Four days of pan-African live music inside the Old Fort in a UNESCO World Heritage town.
events.overview: Sauti za Busara draws taarab, Afrobeat, hip-hop and traditional acts from across Africa to the Old Fort in Stone Town. The venue is intimate and the crowd is a mix of locals and travelers. Spend the rest of your trip on the beaches of the east coast, with spice tours and dhow sailing.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fares via Doha, Istanbul or Addis, with cheap lodging and food on the island.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ndutu, Tanzania","event":"Serengeti wildebeest calving season (Feb peak)","note":"Hundreds of thousands of calves are born on the southern plains, with predators close by."},{"destination":"Mindelo, Cape Verde","event":"Mindelo Carnival (Feb 9)","note":"Island carnival with morna music and a big parade."}]

events.hook: At 4 a.m. every light in the old town goes dark, and lantern-carrying piccolo bands march in.
events.overview: Basel's Fasnacht begins with the Morgestraich at 4 a.m. on the Monday after Ash Wednesday (Feb 15, 2027). For 72 hours cliques in elaborate masks parade, play and satirize local politics, and the Cortège is the big daytime parade. It is a UNESCO-recognized tradition and much more local than other carnivals.
events.costNotes: Switzerland is pricey and fares go to Zurich or Basel, so lodging in nearby France or Germany saves money.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nice, France","event":"Nice Carnival and Menton Lemon Festival (mid-Feb to early Mar)","note":"Flower battles and citrus sculptures on the Riviera."},{"destination":"Lucerne, Switzerland","event":"Lucerne Fasnacht (about Feb 4-9)","note":"Another Swiss carnival, but earlier in the month."}]

events.hook: Thousands of glowing lanterns carrying wishes rise into the night sky over a mountain railway town.
events.overview: The Lantern Festival on Feb 20, 2027 ends the Lunar New Year season, and Pingxi marks it with mass lantern releases beside its old railway tracks. Taipei adds its own lantern displays, night markets and hot springs nearby. Arrive early because trains and the town fill up fast at night.
events.costNotes: Taipei lodging is inexpensive, and the main festival nights are the busiest and priciest.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nagasaki, Japan","event":"Nagasaki Lantern Festival (about Feb 6-20)","note":"Over 10,000 lanterns and Chinese-style parades across the city."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full Moon Lantern Night (Feb 20)","note":"Silk lanterns and floating candles on the river under the full moon."}]

events.event: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade
events.hook: A night parade down Oxford Street that is one of the biggest LGBTQ+ celebrations on the planet.
events.overview: The parade usually falls on the last Saturday of February, with floats, dance troupes and hundreds of thousands watching in the summer heat. The surrounding festival has weeks of parties, art and film, and an after-party follows the parade. Add beaches and harbor swims, as it is peak summer in Sydney.
events.costNotes: Peak summer pricing in Sydney, and the parade date is an estimate until it is confirmed.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Adelaide Fringe (mid-Feb to mid-Mar)","note":"One of the world's biggest fringe festivals, with hundreds of shows in a relaxed city."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Auckland Pride Festival (February)","note":"A smaller Pride season with a lively summer city atmosphere."}]

events.event: Monarch butterfly migration at the Michoacán sanctuaries
events.hook: Millions of monarchs cover the fir forests, then burst into flight as the weather warms.
events.overview: Each winter, monarchs from across North America gather in the oyamel forests of Michoacán. Early March is when they start to leave in huge clouds, and the sanctuaries are some of the most magical places in Mexico. It is also a lesser-known trip with small-town charm.
events.costNotes: Fly to Mexico City or Morelia, then drive or take a tour.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Ignacio Lagoon, Mexico","event":"Gray whale season","note":"Close encounters with mothers and calves, usually through mid-April."},{"destination":"Pismo Beach, USA","event":"Monarch Grove season","note":"A closer, smaller monarch gathering on the California coast."}]

events.hook: Daily firecracker barrages, then a whole city burns its giant satirical sculptures in one night.
events.overview: Valencia spends March on the Fallas: thunderous daytime mascletà displays, flower offerings to the Virgin, and hundreds of towering papier-mâché monuments built by neighborhood groups. The festival ends with the Nit de la Cremà on March 19, when almost every sculpture is set alight. It is loud, chaotic and unlike anything else in Europe.
events.costNotes: Valencia lodging prices jump sharply for Fallas week, especially Mar 15-19.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Castellón de la Plana, Spain","event":"Festa de la Magdalena","note":"A smaller Fallas-style spring fiesta with parades and fireworks in mid-to-late March."},{"destination":"Sitges, Spain","event":"Spring coastal fiestas and Easter-season events","note":"A seaside town near Barcelona with a lively late-March atmosphere and fewer crowds."}]

events.hook: The Formula 1 season opener at Albert Park.
events.overview: The Australian Grand Prix opens the F1 season around Albert Park Lake, with Melbourne's cafe, laneway and sports culture all around it. It is an easy trip to pair with the Great Ocean Road. Confirm the race weekend when the official calendar is announced.
events.costNotes: Race tickets and hotels are the main cost drivers.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"WOMADelaide and Adelaide Fringe","note":"A great music-and-arts alternative in early March."},{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Mardi Gras season","note":"Parties and events across the city around late February to early March."}]

events.event: Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence) and Ogoh-Ogoh parades
events.hook: Monster effigies parade through the night, then a whole island goes silent for 24 hours.
events.overview: The eve of Nyepi features wild ogoh-ogoh parades with giant demon effigies, followed by a day when Bali shuts down: no lights, no travel and no flights. It is an unusual religious and cultural experience, and the stars are spectacular. The exact date depends on the Balinese calendar, so confirm locally.
events.costNotes: Bali's airport closes for Nyepi, so plan flights around it.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lombok, Indonesia","event":"Nyepi observances in Hindu communities","note":"A quieter way to see Balinese-Hindu traditions."},{"destination":"Paro, Bhutan","event":"Paro Tsechu","note":"Masked dances at the Paro monastery; the dates usually fall in late March or April, so check the year's schedule."}]

events.hook: Film, music and tech take over Austin for nine days.
events.overview: SXSW combines hundreds of live music showcases, film premieres and tech talks across the city. It is a good fit for people who like to discover new bands and ideas, with plenty of free events around the official ones. Barbecue and live music venues fill the gaps.
events.costNotes: Austin lodging spikes during SXSW; book early or stay outside downtown.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"Spring festivals and live music season","note":"Great for music lovers who want a less corporate scene."},{"destination":"Miami, USA","event":"Ultra Music Festival","note":"A huge electronic music festival, usually in late March."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest St Paddy's party, in the city where it started.
events.overview: Dublin's multi-day St Patrick's Festival peaks with the national parade on March 17, plus street theatre, concerts, and a céilí-and-pub scene across the city. It is the original, and the best place to feel the holiday's mix of tradition and mayhem. Add day trips to Howth or the Wicklow Mountains.
events.costNotes: Dublin accommodation is at its yearly peak around March 17.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Galway, Ireland","event":"St Patrick's Week parade and trad sessions","note":"A smaller, more musical celebration on the west coast."},{"destination":"Savannah, USA","event":"St. Patrick's Day Parade","note":"One of the biggest US celebrations, with green fountains and a long parade."}]

events.hook: Throw colored powder in the town where Holi began.
events.overview: Mathura and Vrindavan are Krishna's birthplace and childhood home, and they celebrate Holi for a week or more. Expect flower Holi, widow Holi, and the Lathmar Holi in nearby Barsana. The main Holi is around March 22, with Holika Dahan bonfires the night before. It is messy, joyful and best done with a local guide.
events.costNotes: Cheap local costs, but flights to Delhi and hotels near Holi are pricier.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jaipur, India","event":"Holi and the Elephant Festival","note":"Royal-style Holi with the city's palaces and bazaars as a backdrop."},{"destination":"Kathmandu, Nepal","event":"Fagu Purnima (Holi)","note":"Colorful celebrations around Basantapur Durbar Square."}]

events.hook: Candlelit processions, thundering drums and incense-wrapped floats move through Seville's old streets.
events.overview: Seville's Holy Week is Spain's most dramatic: dozens of brotherhoods carry ornate pasos through the old town in hooded robes, with saetas sung from balconies. It is a deeply religious spectacle that also happens to be spectacular theatre, and it comes with orange blossom in the air. The Madrugá overnight procession (Thursday night to Good Friday) is the high point.
events.costNotes: Holy Week lodging is expensive and many places require minimum stays.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Antigua, Guatemala","event":"Semana Santa and alfombra carpets","note":"Streets are covered in sawdust-and-flower carpets just before the processions pass."},{"destination":"Málaga, Spain","event":"Semana Santa","note":"Grand tronos and a strong atmosphere, usually with fewer visitors than Seville."}]

events.hook: Temples, canals and hillsides turn pink for a few brief days.
events.overview: Kyoto's sakura season is narrow and unmissable, with blossoms framing Philosopher's Path, Maruyama Park and Kiyomizu-dera. Peak bloom changes year to year, but usually falls from late March into early April. Evening illuminations add an extra dimension.
events.costNotes: Peak sakura week is the most expensive time of year in Kyoto.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Cherry blossom season","note":"Bloom usually peaks a few days before Kyoto, with a mix of parks and riverbanks."},{"destination":"Hirosaki, Japan","event":"Hirosaki Cherry Blossom Festival","note":"This northern festival is later, in late April, so it works as a backup if you miss the Kyoto peak."}]

events.hook: Africa's grandest jazz weekend, set against Table Mountain.
events.overview: The Cape Town International Jazz Festival brings African and international jazz stars to multiple stages over two days. Add Cape Town's wine country, penguins and mountain hikes to make a full trip. The festival's dates have shifted in recent years, so verify them before booking.
events.costNotes: Long-haul flights are the biggest expense; local costs are moderate.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Stellenbosch, South Africa","event":"Harvest season in the Cape Winelands","note":"Wine estates in late summer and early autumn, with tastings and cellar tours."},{"destination":"Serengeti (Ndutu), Tanzania","event":"Wildebeest calving season","note":"The calving season is strongest in February but still active into March."}]

events.hook: The world's most prestigious hula competition fills a small Big Island town for one week.
events.overview: Merrie Monarch is a week-long celebration of Hawaiian culture, with kahiko and auana hula, a craft fair and a parade. The competition nights are held at Edith Kanakaʻole Stadium. It is far more rooted in culture than a tourist luau. The festival follows Easter, so the exact days are estimated.
events.costNotes: Hilo lodging is scarce and pricey this week, and a rental car is essential.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Honolulu, Hawaii, USA","event":"Spring on Oʻahu and local hula halau shows","note":"Easier lodging and flights if Hilo is sold out."},{"destination":"Papeete, French Polynesia","event":"Tahitian dance and cultural events","note":"Another Polynesian dance tradition, though the big Heiva festival is in July."}]

events.hook: A six-stage, 250 km self-supported ultramarathon across the Sahara.
events.overview: Runners carry their own gear across dunes and dry riverbeds in one of the world's toughest endurance races. Spectators can base themselves near the Merzouga dunes, take desert tours and watch the bivouac and finish-line scenes. The dates follow the usual early-April pattern and need confirming.
events.costNotes: Includes desert 4x4 transfers and a camel trek or camp night.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Spring souks and Atlas day trips","note":"An easy base with direct-ish flights and warm April weather."},{"destination":"Wadi Rum, Jordan","event":"Desert camping season","note":"A similar Sahara-style desert experience in the best spring weather."}]

events.event: Keukenhof Tulip Season and Bollenstreek Bulb Fields Peak
events.hook: Seven million bulbs and miles of striped tulip fields at their narrow peak.
events.overview: Keukenhof's gardens bloom alongside the surrounding bulb fields between Haarlem and Leiden, which are best cycled in mid-April. Peak colour lasts only a couple of weeks and shifts with the weather, so dates are an estimate. Pair it with Amsterdam and the museums.
events.costNotes: Amsterdam-area lodging is expensive in tulip season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Skagit Valley, Washington, USA","event":"Skagit Valley Tulip Festival","note":"A domestic tulip alternative, running through April."},{"destination":"Istanbul, Turkey","event":"Istanbul Tulip Festival","note":"The tulip's original home, with city parks in bloom through April."}]

events.hook: Thailand's New Year turns an entire moat-ringed city into a giant water fight.
events.overview: Songkran in Chiang Mai combines temple rituals, Buddha-washing and parades with an enormous street water battle around the old city moat. It is the best place in Thailand to see both the solemn and the playful sides. Pack waterproof bags and expect many businesses to close.
events.costNotes: Includes a domestic flight from Bangkok.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Pi Mai Lao New Year","note":"A gentler, more traditional take on the same New Year, around Apr 14-16."},{"destination":"Siem Reap, Cambodia","event":"Khmer New Year","note":"Celebrated at the temples of Angkor around Apr 14-16."}]

events.hook: Flamenco dresses, sherry, horse carriages and a thousand casetas lit up all night.
events.overview: Seville's spring fair is a week of dancing sevillanas, drinking rebujito and parading horses through a tent city. Many casetas are private, so go with local connections or use the public ones. Dates are estimated from the usual rule of two weeks after Easter.
events.costNotes: Seville accommodation prices spike during Feria.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Sherry bodegas and flamenco season","note":"A quieter base with a similar Andalusian feel."},{"destination":"Córdoba, Spain","event":"Cruces de Mayo preparations and patios","note":"Spring courtyards and festivities nearby, though the patio festival peaks in May."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest annual marathon, cheered on by half a million spectators.
events.overview: Patriots' Day Monday turns Boston into a running festival, with the expo, the Red Sox morning game and the hills of Newton. Even if you don't run, the atmosphere along Wellesley's scream tunnel and Boylston Street is unmatched. Combine it with Revolutionary War history.
events.costNotes: Hotel and Airbnb prices roughly double race weekend.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Washington, D.C., USA","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival wrap-up","note":"The festival runs into mid-April, but peak bloom usually falls in late March or early April."},{"destination":"New Orleans, USA","event":"French Quarter Festival","note":"Free music festival typically held mid-April."}]

events.hook: A nine-day, 300 km procession carrying the sea goddess through the night with firecrackers and flowing crowds.
events.overview: Hundreds of thousands follow the Mazu palanquin through Taiwan's towns, with roadside food, incense, drums and folk troupes. It is one of the world's great religious processions and is little known outside Asia. Dates are set by the lunar calendar and by temple divination, so confirm closer to the time.
events.costNotes: Taiwan is good value, and the high-speed rail pass is the main transport cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tainan, Taiwan","event":"Temple culture and street food","note":"Taiwan's oldest city, with a deep temple-festival tradition."},{"destination":"Hong Kong","event":"Cheung Chau Bun Festival","note":"A quirky island festival, though it usually falls in May."}]

events.hook: Late-blooming sakura frame a moated castle, and the petals float on the water in a pink carpet.
events.overview: After the south's blossoms have faded, Hirosaki's 2,600 trees bloom around the castle moat with night illuminations and food stalls. It is far less crowded than Kyoto and has a distinct local flavour, with apple country nearby. Peak bloom depends on the season, so the dates are an estimate.
events.costNotes: Includes a domestic flight or shinkansen from Tokyo.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Takayama Spring Festival (Sanno Matsuri)","note":"Ornate festival floats and puppets, held Apr 14-15."},{"destination":"Matsumae, Japan","event":"Matsumae Cherry Blossom Festival","note":"Hokkaido's southern castle town has some of Japan's last blossoms, in late April and early May."}]

events.hook: Standing in the dark with thousands at the Australian War Memorial at dawn.
events.overview: Anzac Day commemorates Australian and New Zealand soldiers with a pre-dawn service, a national ceremony and veterans' marches. Canberra's Dawn Service at the War Memorial is the national focal point. Autumn weather is crisp and clear, and the city's museums and wineries fill the rest of the trip.
events.costNotes: Canberra rooms fill up near Anzac Day, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Wellington, New Zealand","event":"Anzac Day Dawn Service at the National War Memorial","note":"A moving service in a compact, walkable capital."},{"destination":"Gallipoli, Turkey","event":"Anzac Day services at Anzac Cove","note":"The original site of the commemoration, with limited access and early-morning transport."}]

events.hook: Epitaph processions, pot-smashing from balconies and midnight fireworks on a Greek island.
events.overview: Corfu's Holy Week is one of Greece's most distinctive, with brass bands, candlelit processions and the Holy Saturday pot-throwing in the old town. Easter Sunday brings lamb on spits and feasting across the island. Spring flowers are out and the summer crowds are not.
events.costNotes: Easter week is high season for Greek travel, so expect higher flight prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Patmos, Greece","event":"Holy Week at the Monastery of St. John","note":"A quieter and deeply spiritual island Easter."},{"destination":"Bucharest, Romania","event":"Orthodox Easter and the midnight Resurrection service","note":"Candlelit services plus very low costs on the ground."}]

events.hook: Two minutes of thoroughbred thunder wrapped in mint juleps, giant hats and a week-long Southern party.
events.overview: The 153rd Run for the Roses at Churchill Downs is held on the first Saturday of May. Derby Week adds fireworks, a steamboat race and bourbon-trail tastings. It is America's most theatrical sporting day.
events.costNotes: Derby-week lodging roughly doubles or triples, and tickets are the main extra cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Baltimore, USA","event":"Preakness Stakes (around May 15)","note":"Second leg of the Triple Crown with a much more relaxed infield party."},{"destination":"Memphis, USA","event":"Memphis in May festival","note":"A month of barbecue contests, blues and big outdoor concerts."}]

events.hook: A Berber valley celebrates its Damask rose harvest with parades, folk music and a rose queen.
events.overview: Each spring the Dades Valley, known as the Valley of Roses, picks its blooms for rosewater and oils. The town marks the harvest with folk dancing, a flower-covered parade and a market. Combine it with kasbahs, gorges and a Sahara night.
events.costNotes: Low local costs, but the festival dates shift each year, so confirm before booking flights.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Grasse, France","event":"Expo Rose (mid-May)","note":"The perfume capital fills its old town with rose displays and fragrance workshops."},{"destination":"Kazanlak, Bulgaria","event":"Rose Festival (usually early June)","note":"Bulgaria's Rose Valley hosts a rose-picking ritual and a parade, just after May."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of tulips bloom along the Rideau Canal in a gift from the Dutch royal family.
events.overview: The festival began as thanks for Canada's role in World War II and the Dutch royals' time in Ottawa. Dominion Arboretum and Commissioners Park fill with blooms alongside live music and a craft market. Easy side trips include Montreal and Gatineau.
events.costNotes: Mid-range costs, and bloom timing depends on the spring weather.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Holland, USA","event":"Tulip Time Festival (early to mid May)","note":"Michigan's Dutch-heritage town, with parades and wooden-shoe dancing."},{"destination":"Lisse, Netherlands","event":"Keukenhof (closes mid-May)","note":"The famous garden is at its final peak in early May."}]

events.hook: Tens of thousands of glowing paper lanterns flood downtown Seoul in a UNESCO-listed parade.
events.overview: This festival leads up to Buddha's Birthday and fills Jogyesa Temple and Jongno with lantern displays. The Saturday night lantern parade is the main event. It also offers temple food, tea and lantern-making workshops.
events.costNotes: Seoul is good value, and the festival weekend raises hotel prices only slightly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Borobudur, Indonesia","event":"Vesak at Borobudur (around May 20)","note":"Monks walk to the temple and thousands of lanterns are released at the full moon."},{"destination":"Colombo, Sri Lanka","event":"Vesak lantern season (around May 20)","note":"Bright pandals and lantern displays light up the whole city."}]

events.hook: Red carpets, yachts and premieres on the Croisette.
events.overview: The world's most glamorous film festival fills the Riviera with stars and premieres. Most screenings are for accredited guests, but the public can watch the red carpet and attend open-air cinéma de la plage screenings. It is a good base for Nice, Antibes and Monaco.
events.costNotes: Lodging peaks sharply during the festival, and staying in Nice is cheaper.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Monte Carlo, Monaco","event":"Monaco Grand Prix (usually late May or early June)","note":"Street-circuit racing and a yacht-lined harbor within an hour of Cannes."},{"destination":"Brighton, UK","event":"Brighton Festival (May)","note":"England's largest arts festival, spread across the seaside city."}]

events.hook: A million pilgrims arrive by horse, wagon and foot for Spain's wildest religious pilgrimage.
events.overview: Brotherhoods from across Andalusia travel in flower-decked wagons through Doñana marshland to a small white village. Everyone sings and dances in flamenco dress until the Virgin is carried out before dawn on Whit Monday. It is deeply Andalusian and little known abroad.
events.costNotes: Stay in Seville or Huelva because the village has almost no lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Córdoba, Spain","event":"Festival de los Patios (early to mid May)","note":"Private whitewashed courtyards open to visitors, full of flowers."},{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Feria del Caballo (usually May)","note":"Horse parades, sherry and flamenco in a tented fairground."}]

events.hook: A 1,400-year-old Heian court procession winds through Kyoto in silk robes and ox-drawn carriages.
events.overview: On May 15 about 500 participants in Heian-era costume march from the Imperial Palace to Shimogamo and Kamigamo shrines. It is one of Kyoto's three great festivals, and the setting is lush spring greenery. It is postponed by a day if it rains.
events.costNotes: Kyoto hotels are pricey in May, and paid grandstand seats are optional.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Kanda Matsuri (main festival year, mid-May) or Sanja Matsuri (about May 21 - 23)","note":"Portable shrines and rowdy crowds fill Asakusa and the old city."},{"destination":"Fukuoka, Japan","event":"Hakata Dontaku (May 3 - 4)","note":"Golden Week parades with two million spectators and street dancing."}]

events.hook: A whole nation in bunad and flags, with thousands of children marching past the Royal Palace.
events.overview: Norway's national day is celebrated with the Children's Parade, brass bands, and ice cream and hot dogs. The royal family waves from the palace balcony. Long spring light and rosy fjord scenery make it a lovely time to visit.
events.costNotes: Norway is expensive, and flights usually connect via London or Amsterdam.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bergen, Norway","event":"17 May children's parades","note":"Among the biggest in the country, with a fjord-town backdrop."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Midnight sun begins (about May 20)","note":"The sun stops setting in the Arctic around the third week of May."}]

events.hook: The Opera House and harbor become canvases for the Southern Hemisphere's biggest light festival.
events.overview: Each winter Vivid turns Sydney into an open-air gallery of light sculptures and projections. The Opera House sails, Circular Quay and Darling Harbour are the highlights. Live music and food events add to the evening program.
events.costNotes: Winter-season hotel rates and the long flight are the main costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hobart, Australia","event":"Dark Mofo (usually mid-June)","note":"A moodier winter arts festival, just after the May dates."},{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Melbourne International Jazz Festival (late May to early June)","note":"Intimate jazz venues across the city's laneways."}]

events.hook: A quarter-million fans watch 33 cars hit 230 mph at the Brickyard.
events.overview: The 111th Indy 500 is held on Memorial Day weekend at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway. It is one of the world's biggest single-day sporting events, with a tradition of milk, a pre-race parade and a huge infield party. Qualifying weekends earlier in May add more racing.
events.costNotes: Race-week lodging is high, and grandstand tickets are the main extra cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Charlotte, USA","event":"Coca-Cola 600 (May 30)","note":"NASCAR's longest race, held on the same weekend."},{"destination":"Isle of Man, UK","event":"Isle of Man TT (late May to early June)","note":"Road racing at over 200 mph on public roads."}]

events.event: Great Wildebeest Migration: Grumeti River crossings
events.eventDates: Jun - early Jul (herds in the western corridor)
events.hook: Over a million wildebeest funnel toward crocodile-filled rivers in the world's greatest wildlife spectacle.
events.overview: In June the herds usually move through the Western Corridor and the Grumeti River, then head north toward the Mara. Crossings can be dramatic, but timing depends on rain and the herds' movements. Cooler, drier weather and green landscapes make it a strong safari month.
events.costNotes: Lodges and camps replace Airbnbs; park fees and safari transfers dominate costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Maasai Mara, Kenya","event":"Herds building toward the Mara River","note":"The big Mara crossings usually begin in July, so go late in the month or later."},{"destination":"Essaouira, Morocco","event":"Gnaoua World Music Festival","note":"A different kind of Africa trip built around Gnawa music, usually held in late spring or early summer."}]

events.event: Tuen Ng Dragon Boat Festival & International Dragon Boat Races
events.hook: Drums pound, paddles flash and Victoria Harbour turns into a racecourse on the original dragon boat holiday.
events.overview: Tuen Ng falls on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month, which is June 9, 2027. Hong Kong marks it with dragon boat races at Stanley and Tsim Sha Tsui, zongzi rice dumplings and the Cheung Chau waterfront. Race-day schedules are usually announced only a few months ahead.
events.costNotes: Hotels and Airbnbs run higher around the public holiday; the city is hot and humid in June.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gangneung, South Korea","event":"Gangneung Danoje Festival (UNESCO)","note":"Shamanic rites, mask dance and traditional wrestling held around the same lunar Dano date."},{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Dragon Boat Festival races at Dajia Riverside Park","note":"Taiwan's biggest races, held on the same holiday with excellent street food."}]

events.hook: Tens of thousands of dancers in neon happi coats take over Sapporo's streets while the rest of Japan is in rainy season.
events.overview: YOSAKOI Soran blends Kochi's yosakoi dance with Hokkaido's Soran Bushi folk song. About 280 teams perform on street stages and in Odori Park. Hokkaido skips the June rains, so it is a good time for a trip that also takes in ramen alleys and the northern countryside.
events.costNotes: Flights connect via Tokyo; Sapporo is much cheaper than Tokyo for lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kanazawa, Japan","event":"Hyakumangoku Matsuri","note":"Samurai-era procession in the old castle town, usually in the first week of June."},{"destination":"Hakodate, Japan","event":"Early summer in Hokkaido's port city","note":"Seafood, night views and the Hakodate Port Festival run into the summer."}]

events.eventDates: Race Jun 12-13 (race week from about Jun 9)
events.hook: Hypercars, camping fields and a sunrise finish after 24 straight hours of racing.
events.overview: The world's most famous endurance race now has a full factory hypercar field. The week includes the drivers' parade through town, fan campsites and a funfair. Even non-racing fans get swept up in the all-night atmosphere.
events.costNotes: Lodging prices spike for race week; the experiential figure includes grandstand or general admission tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Isle of Man, UK","event":"Isle of Man TT motorcycle races","note":"Road racing that wraps up in the first half of June."},{"destination":"London, UK","event":"Wimbledon Championships","note":"Starts around June 28, so it suits a later-month trip."}]

events.event: Calcio Storico Fiorentino and Feast of San Giovanni
events.hook: Renaissance-costumed rivals fight a bare-knuckle ball game in Piazza Santa Croce, then fireworks light the Arno.
events.overview: Four neighborhood teams play a brutal 16th-century hybrid of football, rugby and wrestling. The final falls on the feast day of St. John, Florence's patron saint, and ends with the Fireworks of the Fochi over the river. The city is crowded but lively.
events.costNotes: Peak-season Florence pricing; match tickets sell out quickly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Porto, Portugal","event":"Festa de São João do Porto","note":"A June 23-24 street party with grilled sardines and plastic hammers."},{"destination":"Pisa, Italy","event":"Luminara di San Ranieri","note":"Tens of thousands of candles light the Arno on June 16."}]

events.hook: Southern Hemisphere winter opens with fireworks, snow, street parties and ski-town energy.
events.overview: The festival kicks off the ski season in the Southern Alps with live music, fireworks, a parade and mountain events. It is a lesser-known way to see New Zealand's adventure capital at its liveliest. Pair it with skiing at Coronet Peak or The Remarkables.
events.costNotes: Includes a couple of ski or activity days; the festival dates are an estimate pending the official announcement.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Vivid Sydney (through about mid-June)","note":"A light, music and ideas festival that usually runs from late May into the first half of June."},{"destination":"Hervey Bay, Australia","event":"Humpback whale migration begins","note":"Humpbacks begin arriving off eastern Australia around June."}]

events.hook: The Inca winter solstice ritual is staged on the ancient ceremonial grounds above Cusco.
events.overview: Inti Raymi is a large reenactment of the Inca sun festival. It starts at Qorikancha, moves through the Plaza de Armas and ends at the Sacsayhuamán ruins. June is dry season, which makes it a good time to combine the festival with Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley.
events.costNotes: Reserved seating at Sacsayhuamán is extra, and Machu Picchu permits need booking well ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tiwanaku, Bolivia","event":"Aymara New Year (Willkakuti)","note":"Dawn sun ceremonies at the ruins around June 21."},{"destination":"Otavalo, Ecuador","event":"Inti Raymi and San Juan festivities","note":"Andean solstice celebrations with music, dancing and processions in the highlands."}]

events.hook: The Women's World Cup comes to South America for the first time, with the final at the Maracanã.
events.overview: Brazil hosts the first Women's World Cup in South America, with matches in several cities across the country. Rio is a good base because of the beaches and the city's football culture. Match schedules and Rio's match allocation will be confirmed later, so check them before booking.
events.costNotes: Includes a few match tickets; accommodation near venues will be tight.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Campina Grande, Brazil","event":"O Maior São João do Mundo","note":"A month-long June folk festival with forró, bonfires and quadrilha dancing."},{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Roland-Garros finals weekend","note":"The clay-court finals wrap up around June 5-6 if you want an early-month sports trip."}]

events.hook: Dance around a flower-wreathed maypole beside Lake Siljan in near-endless daylight.
events.overview: Midsummer is Sweden's biggest holiday, and Dalarna is where it is most traditional. Leksand and Rättvik hold maypole raisings, folk costumes and fiddle music, with herring, new potatoes and strawberries on the table. Leksand's longboat church-rowing tradition gives the lake region extra character.
events.costNotes: Rural cabins near the lake book early; Sweden is pricey for food and drink.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tallinn, Estonia","event":"Jaaniöö (Midsummer Night) bonfires","note":"Bonfires and folk celebrations on June 23-24."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Midnight Sun Marathon","note":"Run or watch beneath a sun that never sets, usually in mid to late June."}]

events.hook: Two rival bull-themed troupes stage Amazon myth operas in the jungle's own Carnival.
events.overview: Boi Garantido (red) and Boi Caprichoso (blue) compete for three nights in the Bumbódromo. The shows use huge floats, indigenous legends, drums and thousands of performers. Reaching the island means flying to Manaus and then taking a short flight or a river boat.
events.costNotes: Lodging is scarce and often priced as festival packages; transfers from Manaus are included in the experiential figure.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Caruaru, Brazil","event":"São João festival","note":"Northeastern June festival with forró, corn dishes and bonfires."},{"destination":"São Luís, Brazil","event":"Bumba-meu-boi season","note":"A related folk tradition performed throughout June in Maranhão."}]

events.hook: Towering wooden floats roll through Kyoto's streets in Japan's grandest, month-long summer festival.
events.overview: Gion Matsuri is one of Japan's three great festivals and has run for over 1,000 years. The Yoiyama evenings before the Jul 17 Saki Matsuri procession fill the old center with lanterns, street food and people in yukata. Float-raising and neighborhood rituals run all month.
events.costNotes: Kyoto lodging peaks around Jul 15-17, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Osaka, Japan","event":"Tenjin Matsuri","note":"Japan's other big July festival, with boat processions on the river and fireworks, usually Jul 24-25."},{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Hida folk villages and summer festivals","note":"A quieter mountain-town option with traditional crafts, markets and small-town matsuri."}]

events.hook: Tahiti's biggest cultural festival of traditional dance, drumming, canoe races and sports.
events.overview: Heiva i Tahiti is a month-long celebration of Polynesian culture, with dance and chant competitions at To'ata Square, outrigger canoe races, fruit-carrying races and javelin throwing. Combine it with island-hopping to Moorea or Bora Bora.
events.costNotes: Everything in French Polynesia is expensive and food costs are high.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Rarotonga, Cook Islands","event":"Te Maeva Nui (typically early August)","note":"A similar Polynesian cultural festival, just after July."},{"destination":"Honolulu, USA","event":"Prince Lot Hula Festival (mid-July)","note":"A hula festival, easier and cheaper from LAX."}]

events.hook: Ten days of rodeo, chuckwagon races and pancake breakfasts in the self-styled Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth.
events.overview: The Stampede takes over Calgary with professional rodeo, the Evening Show, a midway and free pancake breakfasts on street corners. The Rockies and Banff are 90 minutes away, which makes it easy to combine with mountain hiking.
events.costNotes: Stampede week hotel and Airbnb prices roughly double.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cheyenne, USA","event":"Cheyenne Frontier Days","note":"The big Wyoming rodeo, usually the last two weeks of July."},{"destination":"Banff, Canada","event":"Peak alpine hiking season","note":"A good add-on after the Stampede, and nature rather than a time-locked event."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest bike race launches from Barcelona in 2027.
events.overview: The 2027 Tour opens with a Catalan Grand Départ, with team presentations and the first stages around Barcelona. Combine the opening weekend with the city's beaches, Gaudí and late-night tapas. Spectators can also follow the race through the Pyrenees or to the Paris finale.
events.costNotes: Barcelona in July is high season and Grand Départ weekend will be pricier.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Tour de France final stage","note":"The Champs-Élysées finish is on Jul 25."},{"destination":"London, UK","event":"Wimbledon Championships","note":"Another famous sporting event, with finals around Jul 10-11."}]

events.hook: Nine days of white-and-red revelry with the daily encierro at 8am.
events.overview: San Fermín opens with the Chupinazo rocket on Jul 6 and has daily bull runs, parades, giants and music. You can watch from a balcony or fence, and the festival ends with the sad Pobre de Mí song on Jul 14. The city is small and sells out far ahead.
events.costNotes: Pamplona lodging is scarce, so many people stay in nearby San Sebastián or Logroño.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Buñol, Spain","event":"Summer fiestas near Valencia","note":"La Tomatina is in August, so this is a vibe-only alternative with Spanish street festivals in July."},{"destination":"San Sebastián, Spain","event":"Jazzaldia","note":"A jazz festival in late July with pintxos and beaches nearby."}]

events.hook: Mongolia's "three manly games" of wrestling, archery and horse racing on the steppe.
events.overview: Naadam is Mongolia's national festival, with an opening ceremony in the national stadium, wrestling matches and long-distance horse races ridden by children. Pair it with a ger camp in Terelj or Hustai National Park and wild horse spotting.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Seoul or Istanbul and cost more than the local costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Khuvsgul, Mongolia","event":"Lake Khuvsgul summer season","note":"Remote taiga lake and reindeer herders, accessible by plane from Ulaanbaatar."},{"destination":"Ulan-Ude, Russia","event":"Buryat Surkharban festival","note":"Probably unsuitable given travel restrictions, so consider Kazakhstan's steppe instead."}]

events.hook: Over a million wildebeest plunge across the crocodile-filled Mara River.
events.overview: From July the herds arrive in the Mara and cross the river, one of the most dramatic natural spectacles anywhere. The exact timing of crossings depends on rain, so a longer stay improves your chances. Game drives also show lions, cheetahs and elephants.
events.costNotes: Safari camp housing is estimated well above a typical Airbnb, and park fees are high.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti, Tanzania","event":"Northern Serengeti migration","note":"The herds are near the Kogatende and Mara River area in the same period."},{"destination":"Cape Town, South Africa","event":"Whale watching season in Hermanus","note":"Southern right whales arrive from about July."}]

events.hook: Opera, drama and orchestras in Mozart's baroque hometown.
events.overview: The Salzburg Festival is one of the world's top classical music and theater festivals, with Jedermann performed on the cathedral square and many opera productions. The Alpine setting and Lake District nearby make for a good trip in between performances.
events.costNotes: Tickets are the main variable and can run hundreds of dollars each.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bayreuth, Germany","event":"Bayreuth Festival","note":"The Wagner festival opens around Jul 25."},{"destination":"Verona, Italy","event":"Arena di Verona Opera Festival","note":"Opera in a Roman amphitheater through summer."}]

events.hook: Oaxaca's eight regions dance in feathers and embroidered costumes on the Cerro del Fortín.
events.overview: The Guelaguetza is a celebration of Indigenous Oaxacan dance and music held on two Mondays in July, with parades, mezcal tastings and markets throughout the city. Oaxaca's food, including mole and tlayudas, makes it a great culinary trip too.
events.costNotes: Flights to Oaxaca from LAX typically connect through Mexico City.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Summer food and mezcal scene","note":"A good complement with museums and markets."},{"destination":"Quito, Ecuador","event":"Inti Raymi-related festivities in the Andes","note":"Indigenous traditions, though mostly around late June."}]

events.hook: Japan's biggest music festival in the mountains of Niigata.
events.overview: Fuji Rock takes place at the Naeba ski resort with international headliners, forest stages and a famously clean, friendly atmosphere. Dates are usually the last full weekend of July and lineups are announced in spring.
events.costNotes: Ticket and shuttle costs are included in the experiential budget, plus a few days in Tokyo.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Sumida River Fireworks","note":"Usually late July, with nightlife and food around the city."},{"destination":"Roskilde, Denmark","event":"Roskilde Festival","note":"Usually late June to early July, so check dates for overlap."}]

events.hook: Four days of Yolngu culture, song and dance on traditional land in north-east Arnhem Land.
events.overview: Garma is Australia's leading Indigenous gathering. Yolngu hosts share ceremony, bunggul dance, art, forums and bush food at Gulkula. Attendance is limited, with only a few thousand places and a ticket price that covers meals and camping.
events.costNotes: Festival ticket and Darwin to Gove flights drive the experiential cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Darwin, Australia","event":"Darwin Festival","note":"A tropical arts festival that usually runs through August."},{"destination":"Rarotonga, Cook Islands","event":"Te Maeva Nui Constitution Celebrations","note":"Pacific dance, drumming and island pageantry in early August."}]

events.event: Great Wildebeest Migration Mara River Crossings
events.hook: Over a million wildebeest throw themselves into crocodile-filled water.
events.overview: August is peak season for the dramatic Mara River crossings as herds move from the Serengeti into Kenya's Maasai Mara. Dawn game drives and balloon flights put you close to the action. Exact crossing days depend on rains and herd movements.
events.costNotes: Mara camps and park fees dominate the cost, and August is high season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti, Tanzania","event":"Northern Serengeti Mara River crossings","note":"The same herds from the Tanzanian side, often quieter than the Mara."},{"destination":"Okavango Delta, Botswana","event":"Peak dry-season wildlife concentrations","note":"Elephants and predators gather at the shrinking waters, best by mokoro and on safari."}]

events.event: Total Solar Eclipse over Southern Spain
events.hook: The longest total eclipse of the century crosses Europe, and Andalusia's coast has one of its best seats.
events.overview: On August 2, 2027 the Moon's shadow sweeps across the Strait of Gibraltar and southern Spain in the early evening, with totality lasting over four minutes along the coast. Cádiz, Tarifa and Málaga offer beaches, tapas and clear August skies. Pick a spot well inside the path of totality.
events.costNotes: Eclipse-week lodging in the path of totality will be heavily inflated, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luxor, Egypt","event":"Total solar eclipse with the longest totality on land, over 6 minutes","note":"Same eclipse, with temples as the backdrop and extreme heat."},{"destination":"Tangier, Morocco","event":"Total solar eclipse in the path of totality","note":"A cheaper, more adventurous way to see the same eclipse, a short ferry from Spain."}]

events.hook: Mindanao's harvest thanksgiving turns Davao into a riot of flowers, tribal dance and durian.
events.overview: Kadayawan celebrates Davao's indigenous groups and its harvest of fruits and orchids with street dancing, floral floats and markets. It is easy to combine with Mt. Apo, Samal Island and fruit tasting, at a fraction of the cost of Japan. Dates are estimated, with the main parades on the third weekend of August.
events.costNotes: Philippines costs are low, and the main cost is the long-haul flight.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Baguio, Philippines","event":"Cool-mountain Ibalong and highland culture","note":"Highland towns for a cooler, scenic break."},{"destination":"Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia","event":"Sabah cultural showcases","note":"Alternative Southeast Asian island and cultural trip."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest arts festival turns a medieval city into one giant stage.
events.overview: Thousands of comedy, theatre, cabaret and music shows run across hundreds of venues. The Royal Mile fills with street performers, and the International Festival and the Military Tattoo run alongside. Dates are estimated from the usual early-to-late August pattern.
events.costNotes: Edinburgh housing prices spike dramatically during the Fringe.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salzburg, Austria","event":"Salzburg Festival","note":"Opera and classical music in a Baroque setting through August."},{"destination":"Budapest, Hungary","event":"Sziget Festival","note":"A huge island music festival in mid-August."}]

events.hook: Japan's biggest Obon dance festival, with 100,000 dancers chanting 'fools dance, fools watch'.
events.overview: For four nights during Obon, the streets of Tokushima fill with dancing troupes in indigo kimono and straw hats, accompanied by drums, shamisen and flutes. Anyone can join in the open dancing. It is a joyful, communal festival that few foreign visitors see.
events.costNotes: Obon is a Japanese peak travel week, so book hotels and trains early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Aomori, Japan","event":"Nebuta Matsuri (Aug 2-7)","note":"Giant illuminated lantern floats parade through the city, ideal for an earlier-August trip."},{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Gozan no Okuribi (Aug 16)","note":"Giant bonfires on the mountains send spirits home at the end of Obon."}]

events.hook: The world's largest Native American art market, with about 1,000 artists around the Plaza.
events.overview: Artists from many nations sell jewelry, pottery, textiles and paintings directly to visitors in the heart of Santa Fe. There are also fashion shows, a competition and contests. Dates are estimated from the usual third weekend of August.
events.costNotes: Santa Fe lodging is expensive and sells out for Indian Market weekend.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gallup, USA","event":"Gallup Inter-Tribal Ceremonial","note":"A traditional ceremony of dance, rodeo and craft, usually in mid-August."},{"destination":"Taos, USA","event":"Taos Pueblo and arts events","note":"Historic pueblo and mountain scenery nearby."}]

events.hook: Krishna's birthday is celebrated at his birthplace with midnight aarti, flower-draped temples and swings.
events.overview: Mathura and Vrindavan are the heart of Krishna worship, and Janmashtami brings devotees from across India. Temples are lit up, the deity is bathed and clothed at midnight, and nights fill with song and processions. Dates depend on the Hindu lunar calendar, so confirm closer to travel.
events.costNotes: Costs are low in India, though monsoon-season flights and Delhi hotels vary.
