events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mumbai, India","event":"Dahi Handi human pyramids","note":"Teams build human pyramids to break pots of curd the day after Janmashtami."},{"destination":"Udupi, India","event":"Krishna Janmashtami at Sri Krishna Matha","note":"A distinctive south Indian celebration with costumes and processions."}]

events.hook: A temporary city of art, music and radical self-reliance appears in the Nevada desert.
events.overview: Tens of thousands build an experimental city on a dry lakebed, with giant art installations, themed camps and a ceremonial burn of the Man. You must bring all supplies and carry out all trash. Dates follow the usual run ending on Labor Day.
events.costNotes: Includes ticket, camp supplies and a rental vehicle, with fly-in costs kept low by flying to Reno.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reno, USA","event":"Great Reno Balloon Race and Best in the West events","note":"A gentler Nevada trip, with Reno as the gateway to Burning Man."},{"destination":"Salt Lake City, USA","event":"Utah desert and salt flats events","note":"Another desert landscape for those who want a different kind of adventure."}]

events.hook: Europe's biggest street party: Caribbean music, costumes and jerk chicken for a million people.
events.overview: Every August bank holiday weekend, Notting Hill hosts a huge celebration of London's Caribbean community, with steel bands, sound systems and elaborate costumed parades. Sunday is family day and Monday is the big parade. Pair it with the rest of London's summer events.
events.costNotes: London is expensive in late August and the bank holiday weekend raises prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Rotterdam, Netherlands","event":"Rotterdam Summer Carnival (late July)","note":"A Caribbean-style street parade for those seeking a similar vibe in the Netherlands."},{"destination":"Port of Spain, Trinidad","event":"Caribbean music and cultural events","note":"Carnival-style celebrations at the source of the tradition, though the main Carnival is in February."}]

events.event: Venice International Film Festival & Regata Storica
events.hook: Movie stars on the Lido by day, gondoliers in Renaissance costume racing the Grand Canal by weekend.
events.overview: The world's oldest film festival fills the Lido with premieres and red carpets. The first Sunday of September brings the Regata Storica, a historic pageant of decorated boats on the Grand Canal. Early September also has softer light and thinner crowds than August.
events.costNotes: Festival week pushes lodging up, so staying in Mestre or Padua cuts the housing figure.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Toronto, Canada","event":"Toronto International Film Festival","note":"Another major film festival, running in early-to-mid September."},{"destination":"Trieste, Italy","event":"Barcolana regatta (early October)","note":"A cheaper Adriatic alternative with a sailing spectacle, though it falls just after the month."}]

events.hook: Giant elephant-headed idols parade through Mumbai's streets to the sea in drumming processions.
events.overview: Mumbai's biggest festival honors Lord Ganesha with ornate pandals and ten days of devotion. It ends with Anant Chaturdashi, when millions carry idols to Girgaum Chowpatty and other beaches for immersion. It is loud, crowded and unforgettable.
events.costNotes: India is cheap on the ground, but festival-season flights from LAX can be high.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pune, India","event":"Ganesh Utsav","note":"The festival's historic home, with grand processions and fewer crowds than Mumbai."},{"destination":"Hyderabad, India","event":"Khairatabad Ganesh and Hussain Sagar immersion","note":"Features one of India's tallest idols and a lakeside procession."}]

events.hook: Over a million spring blooms carpet the shores of Lake Burley Griffin.
events.overview: Australia's largest celebration of spring sets out millions of tulips and daffodils in Commonwealth Park, with music, workshops and night events. Canberra's museums and nearby wine country make a good base, and Sydney is a short drive or flight away. It is a lesser-known gem in the southern hemisphere's spring.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Sydney.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Toowoomba, Australia","event":"Carnival of Flowers","note":"A garden festival with a parade, running in mid-to-late September."},{"destination":"Brisbane, Australia","event":"Brisbane Festival","note":"A large arts festival with fireworks, held through September."}]

events.event: Mid-Autumn Festival & Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance
events.hook: A 70-meter dragon bristling with incense sticks dances through the streets under the harvest moon.
events.overview: Mid-Autumn centers on lanterns, mooncakes and moon-gazing. In Tai Hang, a three-night fire dragon dance (an intangible cultural heritage) winds through the neighborhood. Victoria Park fills with lantern displays.
events.costNotes: Hong Kong housing is the main cost, and the dance itself is free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Mid-Autumn moon festival","note":"Locals barbecue in the parks under the full moon."},{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Chuseok","note":"The harvest holiday falls the same week, with hanbok-clad families and palace events."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands pack the Zócalo at 11pm for the Grito, then fireworks and mariachi.
events.overview: On the night of Sept 15, the president rings the bell and shouts the Grito de Dolores to a sea of flags. Fireworks and live music follow, and a military parade fills the next morning. The city's restaurants serve pozole and chiles en nogada, a seasonal dish.
events.costNotes: A short, cheap flight from LAX, with chiles en nogada at a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Guanajuato, Mexico","event":"Independence celebrations and Grito","note":"Colonial streets and a more intimate cradle-of-independence feel."},{"destination":"Dolores Hidalgo, Mexico","event":"Grito at the birthplace of independence","note":"The original Grito site, with a small-town atmosphere."}]

events.hook: Four days of raw-milk cheeses from around the world in the Piedmont hills.
events.overview: Slow Food's biennial festival fills the streets of Bra with cheesemakers, tastings and workshops. Nearby are Barolo and Barbaresco vineyards and the start of white-truffle season in Alba. Lesser-known, and very much a foodie's event.
events.costNotes: Fly to Milan or Turin and rent a car for the Langhe hills.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Alba, Italy","event":"Fiera del Tartufo (white truffle fair)","note":"The truffle season starts in autumn, with the fair running from early October."},{"destination":"San Sebastián, Spain","event":"San Sebastián Gastronomika","note":"Another gastronomic gathering, usually around late September to October."}]

events.hook: Sixteen days, six million visitors and a lot of one-liter steins.
events.overview: The world's largest folk festival opens with the mayor tapping the first keg and a costume parade. Beer tents, rides and Bavarian food fill the Theresienwiese. Go on a weekday morning for a table and the best atmosphere.
events.costNotes: Munich lodging prices spike during the festival, and tent reservations add to the total.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Stuttgart, Germany","event":"Cannstatter Volksfest","note":"The second-largest German beer festival, overlapping Oktoberfest with lower prices."},{"destination":"Bad Dürkheim, Germany","event":"Dürkheimer Wurstmarkt","note":"A wine festival in the Palatinate, with huge wine barrels serving as taverns, in mid-September."}]

events.hook: Southern right whales calve a few meters from the cliff path while the town celebrates.
events.overview: Each spring, southern right whales come into Walker Bay, and Hermanus has some of the world's best land-based whale watching. The festival adds markets, food and music. Combine it with the Cape Winelands and Cape Town.
events.costNotes: Rent a car from Cape Town for the 90-minute drive.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Península Valdés, Argentina","event":"Southern right whale season","note":"Whales calve close to shore in September, with sea-lion and penguin sightings too."},{"destination":"Hervey Bay, Australia","event":"Humpback whale season","note":"Humpbacks rest in the bay from July to early November."}]

events.hook: The world's best rugby nations land in Australia for a six-week spring showdown.
events.overview: Australia hosts the men's Rugby World Cup, with matches in Sydney, Perth, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Newcastle. Pool-stage games in October mean packed stadiums, fan zones and a city-wide party, and you can pair a match with Sydney's harbour in spring.
events.costNotes: Match tickets and tournament-period lodging push prices well above normal.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Perth, Australia","event":"Opening-week Rugby World Cup matches","note":"Quieter and cheaper than Sydney, with beaches and wine country nearby."},{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Rugby World Cup matches and spring racing build-up","note":"Strong food and sports city with a lively October calendar."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of hot-air balloons lift off together at dawn against the Sandia Mountains.
events.overview: The world's largest hot-air balloon gathering features mass ascensions, the dawn patrol and evening balloon glows. Get to Balloon Fiesta Park before sunrise for the best views, then spend your days on Route 66 and the green chile trail.
events.costNotes: Flights are cheap but lodging spikes during fiesta week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cappadocia, Turkey","event":"Daily sunrise balloon flights","note":"Year-round balloon spectacle over fairy chimneys, with good autumn weather."},{"destination":"Santa Fe, USA","event":"Early autumn aspen colour and Fiesta-week art scene","note":"Easy add-on about an hour from Albuquerque."}]

events.hook: Millions of Oromo gather by a crater lake in traditional dress to give thanks for the end of the rains.
events.overview: Irreecha is the Oromo thanksgiving, held at Lake Hora near Bishoftu. Celebrants carry grass and flowers, sing and bless the water in one of Africa's largest cultural gatherings. Pair it with Addis Ababa's coffee culture and the historic north.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, with long-haul flights via Addis the main expense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Masai Mara, Kenya","event":"Great Migration Mara River crossings (final weeks)","note":"Dramatic wildebeest crossings are still possible in early October."},{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Rock-hewn church visits after the rains","note":"Green landscapes and fewer crowds after Meskel season."}]

events.hook: Kolkata becomes an open-air art gallery of towering goddess pandals and all-night processions.
events.overview: Durga Puja is Bengal's biggest festival, with themed pandals, drumming, feasts and the final immersion of the idols in the Hooghly. UNESCO lists it as intangible cultural heritage. The city never sleeps, and pandal-hopping at night is the best way to see it.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, but flights and hotels fill up for puja week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mysuru, India","event":"Mysuru Dasara","note":"Royal palace illuminations and a grand procession over the same Navratri days."},{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Ramlila and Dussehra celebrations","note":"Ghats, Ganga rituals and Ramlila performances."}]

events.hook: Dragon dances, giant floats and Dutch- and Chinese-influenced shows take over Nagasaki's streets.
events.overview: This 400-year-old autumn festival of Suwa Shrine is a mix of Japanese, Chinese and Dutch traditions. Neighbourhood groups perform dragon dances, whale-shaped float parades and drum-heavy shows in shrine grounds and streets. It is a lesser-known alternative to Kyoto's big festivals.
events.costNotes: Book hotels early, since festival days sell out.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Takayama Autumn Festival","note":"Lavish festival floats and lantern-lit night parade on Oct 9-10."},{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Jidai Matsuri","note":"Historical costume parade on Oct 22."}]

events.hook: Hunt, sniff and shave the world's most prized white truffle in Piedmont.
events.overview: Alba's truffle fair brings a market, tastings, truffle-hunting excursions and the Barolo and Barbaresco cellars at harvest time. Autumn mist over the Langhe hills adds to the atmosphere. October is the start of the season, with fewer crowds than November.
events.costNotes: Truffles and fair-weekend lodging are pricey, with flights into Milan or Turin.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Motovun, Croatia","event":"Istrian white truffle season","note":"Lower-priced truffle hunts and hilltop towns."},{"destination":"Kakheti, Georgia","event":"Rtveli grape harvest","note":"Qvevri winemaking and harvest feasts, with some activity into October."}]

events.hook: At dawn the sun lights up the inner sanctuary of Ramses II's temple, as it has for over 3,000 years.
events.overview: Twice a year, sunrise rays reach the statues in the sanctuary of Abu Simbel's Great Temple. Crowds, music and dancing gather outside before dawn. Combine it with an Aswan-Luxor Nile cruise and the temples of Upper Egypt in cooler weather.
events.costNotes: Includes Nile transfers and a pre-dawn Abu Simbel tour.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luxor, Egypt","event":"Karnak and West Bank temples in cool season","note":"Comfortable October temperatures and fewer visitors than winter."},{"destination":"Petra, Jordan","event":"Petra by Night candlelit evenings","note":"Another ancient site experience at a comfortable time of year."}]

events.hook: A walled city turns into Europe's biggest Halloween party, with a carnival parade, fireworks and street costumes.
events.overview: Derry's Halloween festival has a week of spooky events, a carnival parade and fireworks over the Foyle, with the 17th-century walls as a backdrop. It has Celtic Samhain roots and is lesser-known than other Halloween destinations.
events.costNotes: Fly into Belfast or Dublin and rent a car or take a bus.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Dublin, Ireland","event":"Bram Stoker Festival and Dublin Marathon","note":"Gothic literary events plus the Oct 25 marathon."},{"destination":"Salem, USA","event":"Haunted Happenings","note":"A Halloween-month event that is easier to reach from LAX."}]

events.hook: The Pink City glows with lights, markets, fireworks and sweets for India's biggest festival.
events.overview: Diwali centres on Lakshmi Puja around Oct 29, with Jaipur's bazaars lit by lights and decorations. Families light diyas, share sweets and set off fireworks. Shopping before the festival is part of the fun.
events.costNotes: Lodging and trains book early over the Diwali week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Amritsar, India","event":"Bandi Chhor Divas at the Golden Temple","note":"The Golden Temple is lit by thousands of lamps."},{"destination":"Singapore","event":"Deepavali lights in Little India","note":"A smaller, easier-to-reach celebration in Asia."}]

events.hook: Marigold altars, comparsa parades and candlelit cemetery vigils make Oaxaca the heart of Day of the Dead.
events.overview: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead includes street parades, sand tapestries, ofrendas in homes and cemetery vigils. Markets sell pan de muerto, mole and mezcal. It is a heartfelt and visually rich cultural experience.
events.costNotes: Lodging prices peak around Oct 31-Nov 2.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pátzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Night of the Dead on Lake Pátzcuaro","note":"Candlelit island cemeteries in a quieter setting."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Día de Muertos parade and ofrenda displays","note":"Large parade and easy flights from LAX."}]

events.eventDates: approx Nov 5 - 13, peak at full moon around Nov 12-13
events.hook: Thousands of camels, Rajasthani herders and pilgrims gather around a sacred lake under the November full moon.
events.overview: Pushkar's fair combines one of the world's biggest camel markets with sports, folk music, turban contests and a full-moon ritual bath in the lake. It is raw, colorful and well suited to photographers, and you can add Jaipur and Jodhpur.
events.costNotes: Fair-week tent and haveli prices spike; fly into Jaipur and take a 2.5-hour transfer.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali (Kartik Purnima)","note":"Millions of oil lamps light the ghats on the Ganges on the same full moon."},{"destination":"Sonepur, India","event":"Sonepur Mela","note":"Asia's largest cattle fair in Bihar, also held around Kartik Purnima."}]

events.hook: Two million spectators and 50,000 runners cross all five boroughs on the world's biggest marathon day.
events.overview: The marathon runs from Staten Island through Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Manhattan to the finish in Central Park. Run it or cheer from First Avenue, either way it is a citywide party, and early November is a good time for fall color and autumn city life.
events.costNotes: Race-week hotel and Airbnb rates are very high; entry is by lottery or charity place and is not included.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Chicago, USA","event":"Fall city break with Chicago Humanities Festival","note":"Cheaper lodging and a lively cultural calendar after marathon season."},{"destination":"Montréal, Canada","event":"Late-autumn city festivals and food scene","note":"A European-feeling alternative with lower costs and fewer crowds."}]

events.event: Loy Krathong & Yi Peng Lantern Festival
events.eventDates: approx Nov 11 - 14, full moon around Nov 12-13
events.hook: Thousands of paper lanterns rise over the old city while floating krathongs drift down the Ping River.
events.overview: On the full moon of the 12th lunar month, Chiang Mai combines Lanna-style Yi Peng lantern releases with Thailand's national Loy Krathong. Expect parades, temple ceremonies and a magical night sky, and book mass lantern release events well in advance.
events.costNotes: Prices peak for 4-5 nights around the full moon; ticketed lantern release events cost extra.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sukhothai, Thailand","event":"Loy Krathong at the historical park","note":"Light-and-sound shows among ruins where the tradition is said to have begun."},{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Boun That Luang and Lai Heua Fai","note":"Illuminated boats and temple lights on the Mekong at the November full moon."}]

events.hook: Maple-red temples, night illuminations and moss gardens set ablaze at Kyoto's peak foliage.
events.overview: Late November is Kyoto's most spectacular time, with Tofuku-ji, Eikan-do and Arashiyama at their reddest and many temples holding special evening illuminations. The peak varies by a week or so with the weather, so build flexibility into your plans.
events.costNotes: Kyoto's busiest and most expensive season; book lodging 6+ months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nikko, Japan","event":"Autumn leaf season (earlier peak, mid-Oct to early Nov)","note":"Check timing; it is earlier than Kyoto but quieter."},{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Late-autumn foliage at palaces and Bukhansan","note":"Peak color fades by mid-November, with a lower-cost trip."}]

events.hook: Dhow races, donkey races and Swahili poetry on a car-free UNESCO island.
events.overview: Lamu Old Town is East Africa's oldest continuously inhabited Swahili settlement. Its annual festival features dhow sailing races, a henna contest, traditional dance and crafts, and a quiet pace without cars. It is a lesser-known cultural gem that can be combined with Kenyan beaches or safari.
events.costNotes: Routing is LAX to Nairobi then a domestic flight to Lamu; dates vary year to year, so confirm locally.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Stone Town Swahili culture and spice-trade heritage","note":"Similar island culture with more flight options and lodging."},{"destination":"Ilha de Moçambique, Mozambique","event":"Swahili-Portuguese heritage island","note":"Another UNESCO island town, quieter and little visited."}]

events.hook: Red-carpet screenings under the Atlas Mountains, with the medina and Jemaa el-Fnaa as backdrop.
events.overview: Marrakech hosts international filmmakers, with open-air screenings in Jemaa el-Fnaa and tributes to cinema greats. Late November has mild days and cool evenings, good for exploring souks, riads, hammams and the Atlas foothills.
events.costNotes: Riad stays are affordable; most screenings are free or low-cost, but exact dates are announced late.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Essaouira, Morocco","event":"Coastal medina, music and surf scene","note":"A relaxed seaside add-on, 2.5 hours from Marrakech."},{"destination":"Fes, Morocco","event":"Medina and leather tannery season","note":"The best-preserved medieval medina, cooler in November."}]

events.hook: France's 'Capital of Christmas' opens its half-timbered old town to glowing stalls, vin chaud and a giant tree.
events.overview: Dating to 1570, the Christkindelsmärik fills Strasbourg's historic center with chalets selling crafts, bredele cookies and tarte flambée. Opening weekend means fewer crowds than December, and you can make day trips to Colmar and the Alsace wine villages.
events.costNotes: Fly into Frankfurt, Zurich or Paris and take a train; central lodging is expensive during market season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Colmar, France","event":"Colmar Christmas Markets","note":"Smaller, storybook-style markets that open around the same time."},{"destination":"Nuremberg, Germany","event":"Christkindlesmarkt","note":"Germany's best-known market, opening the Friday before Advent."}]
